item.title: EplayerX 1.2.12
item.description:
## 更新日志
- 修复从继续观看移除 Trakt 剧集后，刷新或切换设备时可能重新出现的问题。 - 完善 Trakt 隐藏状态同步，同时保留标记已观看后的下一集推荐。 - 修复 HLS 下载失败后重试丢失已完成分片的问题，改善暂停、恢复与进度保留。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What's New
- Fixed removed Trakt shows reappearing in Continue Watching after a refresh or on another device. - Improved Trakt hidden-state syncing while preserving next-episode suggestions after marking an episode as watched. - Fixed completed HLS segments being discarded on retry, and improved pause, resume, and progress retention.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
